newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHW - DID NOT SELL DSL STAKE TO POSTBANK.
newsitem.headline: BHW - DID NOT SELL DSL STAKE TO POSTBANK.

text.p: German financial services group BHW said on Thursday it had not sold a stake in state-controlled Deutsche Siedlungs und Landesrentenbank, or DSL Bank, to the soon-to-be privatised postal bank, Postbank.

DSL said on Wednesday that BHW had reduced its DSL stake to just above 10 percent from 20.69 percent. Postbank has said it is in talks with DSL on a possible co-operation and there was speculation that it was the buyer.

A spokesman for the BHW group told Reuters the stake had not been sold to Postbank. Ongoing negotiations made it impossible to give more details on the fate of the DSL holding, the spokesman said. DSL is 52-percent state-owned.
The Finance Ministry said on Thursday that it planned to fully privatise the bank, without naming a time-frame. Selling DSL to Postbank was one of several possible options, the ministry added.
